conclusions: Individual controls pass their 15% analytical, geometry and quality checks.
Within each operating-system/architecture pair the Python 3.11/3.12 fields are identical.
Darwin arm64 versus Linux x86_64 differs by 0.4176368793% in Frobenius norm, but 15 of 192 entries violate the frozen per-entry rtol=.02, atol=.01 V/(A m) gate.

Minimum mean ratios differ, consistent with different native tetrahedral decompositions despite equivalent boundary and tissue volumes. Meshing versus compiler/library contributions have not been independently isolated.
A global norm below 2% does not override the prespecified per-entry criterion.
No tolerance, mesh setting, historical result or security rule was changed to obtain green CI.
native_mesh_claim: No bitwise cross-platform mesh identity established
